fato_historico: 2005: The 7.6 Mw Kashmir earthquake leaves 86,000–87,351 people dead, 69,000–75,266 injured, and 2.8 million homeless.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a deep call to anchor your spirit. Just as the Earth hums with quiet resilience after past tremors, you might find profound healing in grounding yourself. It is a good time to cherish the stability you have cultivated and consider how even the most shaken foundations can eventually bloom with new life and gentle wisdom.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest mountains appreciate the quiet peace of a calm, sunny day.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of abundance and inner power.
conselho: Practice gratitude for your physical space and nurture your beautiful, quiet sanctuary.
